selection_rule: A preset recommends defaults only for unbound pstack roles. Equilibrado is the default for a new setup with no existing role choices when no preset is named; it never rewrites existing role choices. Show any preserved binding that differs from a selected preset as an explicit override. Preserve explicit role model/effort values, panel lists, aliases, named-specialist bindings, and the operator's selected main model and effort. A missing required model or effort remains unchanged and needs a choice; do not silently substitute. Choose one mode: a role-aware preset or one upstream global budget, never both.

classes.execution: Roles that implement, repair, tune, or run candidate software changes.
classes.judgment_planning: Roles that plan, explain, design, synthesize, cross-judge, or review.
classes.exploration_tooling: Narrow discovery, investigation, or tool-oriented roles.

coordinator.when: demanding coordination; preserve an explicit operator selection
